recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future request to add more MedicationDispense unavailability concepts or to model the two MedicationDispense concepts as direct SNOMED CT codes should be handled as a new Pharmacy terminology decision, not as a FHIR-17836 reconciliation fix.
issue_request: FHIR-17836 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 by Pharmacy. It requested limiting the MedicationAdministration.statusReason exemplar binding to SNOMED CT 182895007 Drug declined by patient and 242990004 Drug not available for administration, and looking at MedicationDispense.statusReason to add the out-of-stock and off-market drug-not-available concepts while keeping existing codes correct.
initial_application: Jira comments cite implementation commits 8d3e59edd6c60b560cb2e5f0b4f9b47fd6fbd47e for MedicationDispense and 653162b19edb9a15b3e52a1506dc5856ee11ee08 for MedicationAdministration. The underlying commits b34396b1674390c22ec89d309726049035eac234 and aae010ab98bba47803627b3b9f4d1d5adaa76c7e added the MedicationDispense outofstock/offmarket local concepts and changed the MedicationAdministration value set filters to 242990004 and 182895007.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration and MedicationDispense are active approved resources in source/fhir.ini. Their current StructureDefinitions bind the relevant status reason elements to the checked ValueSets. A later combined-branch audit for FHIR-46910 changed MedicationAdministration.statusReason wording but did not reopen or supersede the FHIR-17836 example binding or terminology surface. Quoted Jira search found only the seed issue, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the MedicationAdministration value set contains only the two requested SNOMED CT concept filters, and MedicationDispense's status reason ValueSet includes the local outofstock and offmarket concepts added by the Jira-tagged application.

related_jiras.note: Already represented on the combined branch; it changed MedicationAdministration.statusReason wording and explicitly left the older example binding/terminology surface unchanged.
